key_highlights: ASX tumbles as miners and banks sell off amid $100 oil and rising bond yields
Iron ore weakness spreads, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
WA gold exploration sector active with multiple high-grade discoveries and funding rounds
Labor pivots from gas tax to gas reservation, softening local supply rules to ease Asian fears
Queensland near credit rating downgrade; NSW faces stamp duty revenue hit
Aussie business conditions weakest since pandemic; AUD shocker risk flagged
Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market; banks allegedly defrauded up to $600m
Austal jumps on $1.9b bid; Flagship ups copper stakes as red metal soars
High-end property sees steepest falls while affordable segment remains resilient
Medicare review recommends rebate increases, positive for CSL.AX and healthcare sector

sectors.trend: Mixed: iron ore weakness pressures majors, but gold and copper sub-sectors show strength. WA gold exploration active with multiple discoveries and funding rounds. Austal $1.9b bid signals M&A activity.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from iron ore spread. Gold juniors (Gateway, Auric, Golden Dragon, Kuniko) attract speculative flows. Copper upside supports Flagship and diversified miners.

sectors.trend: Negative. Banks tumble on rising bond yields and credit stress. Bathla collapse hits private credit. $600m bank fraud allegation raises governance concerns.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX under pressure from yield curve steepening and credit risk. Private credit exposure a key vulnerability. Watch NAB.AX and CBA.AX for earnings guidance.

sectors.trend: Oil near $100/bbl triggers TACO (Trump And Chill On) dynamics. Labor shifts from gas tax to reservation model, softening supply rules. Data centres at coal plants signal energy demand surge.
sectors.implications: Woods Point, Origin Energy (ORG.AX), and gas producers benefit from reservation policy. Coal-to-data-centre pivot (AGL.AX, CSG.AX) creates transition narrative. Oil spike pressures importers.

sectors.trend: Medicare review recommends rebate increases, supportive for sector funding. Wall Street billionaire backing new sight-restoration treatment signals innovation pipeline.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SAGE, and healthcare REITs (GPT.AX, ICPL) benefit from policy tailwind. Biotech innovation remains a long-term theme.

sectors.trend: High-end property sees steepest falls; affordable segment resilient. NSW stamp duty hit threatens state revenue. Housing price correction debate intensifies.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, SPG.AX) face mixed signals. Residential construction (Wesfarmers WES.AX, APY.AX) may see volume support from affordable demand. NSW fiscal stress a structural risk.

sectors.trend: AI data centre buildout at coal plants signals energy-tech convergence. Global AI capex (NVIDIA, Mistral, Palantir) continues but valuation concerns emerge.
sectors.implications: ASX-listed data centre and infrastructure plays (VIX.AX, IAG.AX) benefit. Energy demand from AI supports coal and gas transition narrative.

key_themes: Commodity bifurcation: iron ore weak vs gold/copper strong
Energy policy pivot: gas reservation replaces tax, easing Asian supply fears
Credit stress: Bathla collapse and bank fraud allegations
Fiscal fragility: Queensland downgrade risk, NSW stamp duty hit
Business cycle trough: conditions weakest since pandemic
AUD vulnerability: shocker risk amid global yield divergence
Housing bifurcation: luxury correction vs affordable resilience
AI-driven energy demand reshaping transition timeline

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil at $100/bbl driving inflation and TACO volatility
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour domestic gas producers over oil importers; monitor RBA response
Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold and copper exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Queensland credit downgrade and NSW fiscal stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid QLD-linked infrastructure and REIT exposure; monitor state bond spreads

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Private credit contagion from Bathla collapse
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review bank balance sheets for private credit exposure; favour large-cap diversified banks

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD shocker amid global yield divergence
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure; monitor RBA commentary and commodity-linked flows
Favour defensive staples (WES.AX, WOL.AX) and dividend payers over cyclical names

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight WA gold exploration names on multiple high-grade discoveries and funding rounds
opportunities.rationale: Gateway $45M raise, Auric 102koz kicker, Golden Dragon high-grade hits, Kuniko depth extension signal sector momentum

opportunities.recommendation: Position in domestic gas producers ahead of reservation policy implementation
opportunities.rationale: Labor's shift from tax to reservation softens supply rules, easing Asian fears and supporting gas pricing

opportunities.recommendation: Add copper exposure via Flagship and diversified miners
opportunities.rationale: Copper price surge and Flagship's Canadian stake expansion signal structural demand from electrification

opportunities.recommendation: Consider Austal on $1.9b bid as M&A catalyst
opportunities.rationale: Bid provides valuation floor; shipbuilding sector benefits from global rearmament and LNG demand

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore major exposure; rotate to gold and defensive staples
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore weakness spreading amid Chinese inflation and demand concerns; business conditions at pandemic lows

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD and reduce cyclical bank exposure amid credit stress
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla collapse, $600m fraud allegations, and rising yields pressure financials; AUD shocker risk elevated

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid QLD-linked and high-end property exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Queensland near downgrade; luxury property seeing steepest falls; NSW stamp duty hit signals fiscal stress

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in 1-3 month window. Oil at $100, iron ore weakness, and credit stress dominate. RBA may hold or signal caution amid inflationary oil shock. Gold juniors and gas names offer relative outperformance. Expect elevated volatility.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil normalises and gas reservation policy supports energy security. Gold and copper structural demand from electrification and AI data centres provides tailwind. Housing bifurcation continues. Key risk is prolonged business cycle weakness and AUD depreciation.

AUD/USD reaction to global yield divergence

Queensland and NSW state bond spreads
Gold price and WA junior exploration funding
RBA cash rate and forward guidance
